notes: The update notice now works the way it always said it did. There was no repeating check at all: a radio left open asked once, at launch, and then reported that one answer as "Up to date" for as long as the window stayed open -- which is the case the six-hour interval was chosen for. And the launch check itself waited out those six hours, so a machine that had asked in the morning went on saying "Up to date" all day, through any number of relaunches. Opening the radio now asks unless it asked in the last ten minutes, and a repeat runs every six hours while it is open. The dot at the head of the pill blinks: lit for three quarters of every two seconds, snapping on and fading off over sixty milliseconds. The pill itself fades in over the same sixty. A machine set to reduced motion gets both held still. Two controls that were meant to be hidden were drawn on every machine, because a class rule setting display beats the hidden attribute: Open app folder sat permanently beside Reset to defaults instead of appearing only while Shift is held, and the reduced-motion scrolling switch was offered to everyone rather than only to machines that ask for reduced motion.
